patch.value: GH-793: remove or disambiguate list --all so filtered output cannot claim workspace completeness

The list --all alias controls pagination while the command defaults to open statuses, causing an intuitive all-workspace query to return only active rows and label the filtered result complete. Make scope and completeness explicit and token-safe.

Bare --all cannot silently mean only no-truncate; callers receive either a clear error suggesting --status all or an unambiguous replacement; completeness distinguishes full workspace scope from post-filter pagination; total semantics are documented and tested across JSON and TOON; aliases and runtime contracts remain aligned
Prevent agents from confidently treating a filtered list as the complete project timeline
All-status project context becomes explicit and trustworthy
